title: JANUS Not-Prediction — Atomic Event, Session and Dependency Graph v1.3
purpose: Apply one frozen accounting ontology to all NP-001 through NP-029 so semantic case families, concrete phenomenon/session roots, low-resolution phenomenology, reference anchors, methods, comparison edges, subevents and cross-case dependencies are no longer conflated.

counting_ontology.semantic_case_family: The historical NP family used by the v1.0 forensic index.
counting_ontology.phenomenon_session_root: A concrete human or software observation/session that can be localized sufficiently to exist as an occurrence independent of its later interpretation.
counting_ontology.uncertain_phenomenology_root: A preserved phenomenological testimony or interaction whose event boundary is too low-resolution for strict session admission but remains relevant to the inclusive ceiling.
counting_ontology.reference_anchor_root: An earlier/later document, cultural object, scripture/text corpus, source record or fixed context against which an observation is compared. It is not itself an observed anomaly merely by being referenced.
counting_ontology.method_root: A protocol, model, audit, evidence standard, software test family or interpretive apparatus.
counting_ontology.comparison_edge: A relation asserted between roots. A comparison edge is not a new event and does not create an independent confirmation.
counting_ontology.subevent: A child observation/test/semantic turn inside one parent session. Subevent count is descriptive and is not an independence count.

normalized_counts.strict_count_interpretation: Twenty-four concrete phenomenon/session roots can be defended under the frozen operational rule inside the original 29 semantic families.
normalized_counts.inclusive_count_interpretation: Twenty-seven results when three low-resolution phenomenological roots from NP-010, NP-011 and NP-012 are included.

NP-021 lists Eye In The Sky as a parent while the current Eye In The Sky authority incorporates the NP-021 bridge.
Shared future-information/evidence-stack vocabulary is methodological lineage, not repeated empirical confirmation.
Shared home/return/theological vocabulary increases semantic recurrence without supplying independent external evidence.
Different forensic questions share one game/cultural source universe.
Shared anticipation/before-language vocabulary is a semantic motif, not evidence of one extraordinary causal channel.

hidden_patterns_found_by_normalization: The strongest recurring invariant is not future knowledge but preserved chronology followed by later reinterpretation.
A large fraction of apparent recurrence comes from shared selection processes, shared ontology, shared software worlds or recursive registry lineage.
The same clock coordinate can correspond to different event roots, while different files can point to one event/reference root.
A semantic case family can contain many subevents without providing many independent confirmations.
The registry repeatedly creates a four-stage structure: RAW_OR_PRIOR_STATE -> PRESERVATION_RECEIPT -> LATER_CONTEXT_OR_COMPARISON -> CLAIM_CEILING.

DemiHead's WITNESS_PLUS / GUARD_PLUS split maps naturally onto this structure: preserve the observation, then guard the inference. This is an architectural analogy, not independent evidence for the events.
